description: Toyota's Bridge specialist for scanner: starts a scan on the Window or Freezer scanner through the Bridge (read back, sent after a yes); Scala files the page
notes: Toyota's profile maps this name to adapters/bridge_specialist_runner.BridgeSpecialistRunner. The model (Groq, JSON mode) only fills a form; bridge_client/specialists.py checks it against the Bridge's live GET /agents and builds the request. Changes, prints, print cancels and scans are read back and sent only after a yes.
